title: Shangri-La Frontier
premise: Full-dive VR gaming has taken over the world. Shangri-La Frontier is the most ambitious VRMMO ever created — 30 million players, a living world full of secrets, and monsters that learn from every fight. You're logged in.

lore.title: Shangri-La Frontier
lore.text: A next-gen VRMMO with 30 million active players. The world is procedurally alive — NPCs evolve, ecosystems shift, and hidden content unlocks based on collective player behavior. No two experiences are the same. Considered the pinnacle of game design.

lore.title: Unique Monsters
lore.text: Seven ultra-rare boss entities hidden throughout SLF, each with AI-driven combat that adapts to player strategies. Defeating one grants legendary rewards and permanent world changes. Only a handful of players have ever encountered one. They are the game's greatest challenge.

lore.title: Rabbitz (Vorpal Bunny Country)
lore.text: A hidden zone populated by the Vorpal Bunnies — deceptively cute rabbit-like creatures with terrifying combat ability. Their leader Vysache guards secrets tied to the game's deepest lore. Players who earn their trust unlock unique questlines.

lore.title: Lycagon the Nightslayer
lore.text: One of the Seven Unique Monsters. A colossal werewolf boss that hunts at night in the Rabauld Forest. Its AI learns player attack patterns mid-fight and counters them. Defeating Lycagon requires improvisation — no strategy works twice.

lore.title: Ctarnaus
lore.text: One of the Seven Unique Monsters — a skeletal colossus lurking in an underwater ruin. Its arena floods and drains on cycles, changing the fight constantly. Known for one-shotting overconfident raid parties. Drops unknown.

lore.title: Wethermon the Tombguard
lore.text: One of the Seven Unique Monsters. A massive armored knight guarding the deepest dungeon in SLF. No player has defeated it. Its HP pool is rumored to be in the billions. The game's white whale.

lore.title: Full-Dive VR Technology
lore.text: Neural interface tech that fully immerses players in virtual worlds — all five senses simulated. Pain is dampened but present. Logging out is instant. The tech is consumer-grade and affordable, making VR gaming mainstream worldwide.

lore.title: Trash Games
lore.text: Poorly made VR games with broken mechanics, absurd bugs, and nonsensical design. A niche community of players specializes in beating these on purpose, developing unconventional skills that transfer surprisingly well to polished games like SLF.

lore.title: Sunraku
lore.text: A trash-game veteran who entered SLF looking for a real challenge. Plays with a bird-skull mask avatar. Reckless, creative, and terrifyingly skilled — his experience exploiting broken games gives him an unorthodox fighting style that confuses even Unique Monster AI.

lore.title: Pencilgon
lore.text: Sunraku's longtime gaming partner. A methodical player who prefers strategy over chaos. Runs support builds and handles logistics. Calm where Sunraku is reckless. Together they form an unlikely but effective duo.

lore.title: Oicazzo
lore.text: One of the top-ranked players in SLF. Leader of a major guild. Skilled, competitive, and deeply invested in being first to clear endgame content. Respects strength above all else.

lore.title: Guild System
lore.text: Players form guilds to tackle raids, control territory, and compete in PvP seasons. Top guilds have hundreds of members and corporate-level organization. Guild wars reshape the political map. Solo players are rare at high levels.

lore.title: Rabauld Forest
lore.text: A dense, dark forest zone in SLF where high-level monsters roam freely. Day-night cycles affect spawn rates and monster behavior. Lycagon stalks these woods at night. Rich in rare materials but lethal to the unprepared.

lore.title: The Coliseum
lore.text: SLF's main PvP arena where players duel for ranking, rewards, and reputation. Seasonal tournaments draw massive audiences. Fighting styles vary wildly — magic, melee, hybrid, and cheese builds all compete. Top rankers are celebrities.

lore.title: Scenario Quests
lore.text: Dynamic storylines triggered by player actions or world events. NPCs remember what you did. Choices have permanent consequences — betray a town and it stays burned. Scenario quests are the main way hidden content and Unique Monsters are discovered.

lore.title: Vysache
lore.text: Leader of the Vorpal Bunnies in Rabbitz. Despite his cute appearance, he is an ancient NPC with power rivaling Unique Monsters. Acts as a mentor figure to players who prove themselves worthy. His true nature is one of SLF's biggest mysteries.

lore.title: Class and Build System
lore.text: SLF has no fixed classes. Players build from a massive skill tree — melee, magic, crafting, stealth, summoning — mixing freely. Weapon proficiency grows through use. Unique combinations unlock hidden skills. The meta is constantly shifting.

lore.title: The Depths
lore.text: A vast underground dungeon network beneath SLF's main continent. Each floor increases in difficulty exponentially. The lowest floors have never been reached. Wethermon guards somewhere in the abyss. Expeditions here are one-way trips for most.
